summary: The Balance build, keeping Faerie Fire on the boss for the raid. The armor cut doesn't help its spells, so it only costs GCDs.
rotation: Pre-pull: Starfire rank 6 at -3s, so it lands at the pull
Racials, potions and runes on cooldown. Innervate has its own condition.
Elune's Light (Night Elf) with the spell power trinket, and at -0.1s with it and the potion
Faerie Fire first after the pull, and again when it has under 1.5s left
Insect Swarm when it is down, with more than 8s left
Moonfire when its DoT is down, with more than 8s left
Starfire when Clearcasting is up. Wrath doesn't use it up.
Moonfire when a Starfire would not land before the end
Wrath when Eclipse is at 2 charges or fewer and no Wrath is in flight
caveats: Costs 35.8 / 33.4 / 30.6 DPS at 120s / 180s / 300s, against the same build without the duty.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks, so Starfire stops at rank 6. That costs 13.3 DPS at 180s.
The Grovekeeper 5-piece Eclipse bonus would add 12.6 DPS over the 2-piece. Swarming Idol is worth 3.3. Both were measured on older gear.
Mana runs out in 300s fights, where a plain weave is 2 DPS ahead.
Wrath VIII's base damage is ×1.085 the client's value.
Unverified: Omen of Clarity's proc chance on spells, and that Eclipse charges come when Wrath lands.
Only one +2% crit elixir. A second one (Owl) would add 15.1 DPS.
Subtlety 3 (Restoration) is taken for threat. It costs 12.4 / 12.5 / 12.6 DPS at 120s / 180s / 300s against Genesis 5 in its place.
notes: druid__balance.json with the raid's Faerie Fire and Curse of Recklessness off (Forever's two share the minor armor slot, standards 20, so with the curse on the druid's own Faerie Fire adds nothing) and the level60_ff rotation. Everything else is the base request. Night Elf since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick, with the level60_ff rotation regenerated with elune=1 (tools/rotopt/druid_presets.sh), which was req/races/druid__balance-duty-ff.NightElf.json; the same rotation is 0.0 for a Tauren (Elune's Light is the Night Elf's). The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. 2026-11-01: on the launch realms' 2026-10-30 hotfix trees (tools/forever_talents/client/druid.json): the same talents in the new layout (Subtlety moved to row 3), the rotation kept by the knob search, the request's talentsString and rotation edited to match.
